checks: The highest-precedence custom paste handler prevents default synchronously and returns true before async native clipboard reading, blocking CodeMirror empty-text replacement of the selection.
Existing file-image handling uses the same event-consumption pattern; normal text, rich text, URI, copied references and path handling retain their existing flow.
HomeEditor and SessionEditor instantiate the same Composer component, covering both entry points through shared logic.

Tests provide getData consistently with the clipboard payload and use the real CodeMirror editor. They assert actual document/store text, selection and attachment state without suppressing exceptions.
The native fallback performs no editor document transaction, so the fix introduces no empty-paste text-history transaction; no separate undo runtime test was performed.
